key.name: mirror-indicators
key.description: Mirror top bar status indicators on the other monitors.

key.name: mirror-indicator-catalog
key.description: Indicators known to the mirror, per monitor (JSON).

key.name: action-center
key.description: Show quick settings, notifications and the calendar in one popup.

key.name: action-center-banner-click
key.description: What clicking a notification banner does while the Action Center is on: open the Action Center, or activate the notification as GNOME does.

key.name: action-center-width
key.description: Width of the Action Center in pixels; 0 fits its content.

key.name: action-center-swap
key.description: Put the calendar on the left and the notifications on the right.

key.name: action-center-hidden-sections
key.description: Sections not shown: quick-settings, notifications, today, calendar, events, world-clocks, weather.

key.name: one-button
key.description: Replace the clock and the system menu of every bar with one button that opens the Action Center.

key.name: button-elements
key.description: What the button shows, in order: 'indicators' (the system indicators) and 'clock'.

key.name: button-indicator-order
key.description: System indicators listed first, in this order; the others keep GNOME's order.

key.name: button-hidden-indicators
key.description: System indicators the button does not show.

key.name: clock-format
key.description: A GLib date format (strftime style, "\n" for a second line). Empty follows GNOME's clock settings.

key.name: clock-font
key.description: A Pango font description for the clock. Empty uses the theme font.
